kitDescription: Mica: Snow Buddy is an Iron SMG Burst-I Supporter whose value is almost entirely team support. Her Skill 1 builds 'Tidying Up' stacks on the whole team as she lands normal attacks (1 stack per 120 hits, up to 10), and once the stack maxes out the entire team gains +40% Max Ammunition Capacity permanently, stretching everyone's magazines and cutting reload downtime. Her Skill 2 accelerates that stack build (an extra buff stack every 150 hits) and gives herself a permanent +300% burst-gauge fill rate, letting her feed the burst chain much faster. Her Burst cleanses one debuff from the team and grants all allies an ATK buff equal to 39.93% of her own ATK for 5 seconds. In practice she contributes damage indirectly: faster burst cycling, bigger team magazines after a ~45-50s ramp, and a recurring 5-second team ATK injection on each of her Burst-I casts.

redAssertions: S5 skill2 'ROTATION: removing it costs the team Full Bursts' — asserts fbBase > fbNoGauge, but the 20s burst CD bottlenecks at 9 Full Bursts with or without burstGenPct:300 (measured 9 vs 9). verdictRationale: All six kit lines are accounted for: four FAITHFUL encodings (gated max-ammo, self burstGenPct, burst casterAtkPct — the last byte-identical across driver and S6) and two DOCUMENTED_GAPs with the partially-modeled portions (stack clock, self-stack fold) live and pinned, the inert portions (defensive 2%, cross-ally stack reach, cleanse) documented verbatim with ⚑ tiers and recipes. No silent drops, no engine/fidelity misroutes, and the single most dangerous misread (Damage Taken ▼ on allies → boss damageTakenPct, up to +20% fabricated team damage) is explicitly avoided and guard-tested. The stack-gate encoding is the strongest artifact in the packet: activation emerges from the engine's hit-count cadence (frame 2797) and independently matches the S2b reviewer's prose+cadence derivation (~45-50s) and the S6 blind proxy (~50s). Discrimination is real — every driver PIN has a counterfactual run that provably fails it (t=0 passive applies at frame 0; atkPct records raw 39.93; excludeSelf drops a target; removing the fold delays the gate >30s). The lone S5 RED is a blind over-claim (FB count is burst-CD-bottlenecked at 9 either way), classified RECON_ERROR — the driver's encoding is live through the timing channel and the driver's own test pins it correctly. Same-model residual the owner should spot-check: all three agents independently committed to refresh-on-reapply stack semantics for 'stacks up to 10 times, lasts 15 sec' (the standard NIKKE convention), under which the ammo gate opens ~46s; under per-stack-independent decay the gate NEVER opens (0% uptime) — this is the ⚑ M4 binary, documented by everyone but settled by no measurement; a footage read of the Tidying-Up stack counter is the one measurement that would retire it. Recommended GO with ⚑ M4 as the standing refit candidate.
